name: TPC Snoqualmie Ridge
architects: Jack Nicklaus (opened 1999; a TPC course until 2016, now The Club at Snoqualmie Ridge)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP elevation service (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, 1 m, EPSG:32610, box x 584300-587200 / y 5264400-5266800); the 1 m DEM under the course is WA_KingCounty_2021_B21 (tile x58y527, flown 2021-04-01 to 2021-09-07, published 2023-03-03, per the service's identify); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-snoqualmie_ridge, usgs_dem_m.tif)

laz.source: USGS Lidar Point Cloud WA_KingCounty_2021_B21 (WA_KingCo_2_2021), tiles King_1888-1890 and King_1956-1958 from rockyweb.usgs.gov, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-snoqualmie_ridge), each clipped to the world + 100 m by intake.py laz --keep-evlrs; NAD83(2011) / Washington North (US ft), NAVD88 US ft; classes 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures), 2 ground, 7/18 noise and a few others: no vegetation classes
laz.label: 2021 USGS King County lidar

ortho.source: USDA NAIP from the USGS National Map NAIP ImageServer (exportImage, about 0.6 m, EPSG:32610), four JPEG exports placed by their request boxes (intake.py ortho); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-snoqualmie_ridge)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 677694568, 2,324 x 1,744 m in EPSG:32610) + 118 m of scenery (118, not 120, keeps it to 10 chunks east-west), rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred. 2,560 m east-west is over the 2,048 m guideline (COURSE_BUILD.md 6.1).

scorecard_source: GolfPass, The Club at Snoqualmie Ridge scorecard (read 2026-11-13): Mt. Si (the back set) 7,234 yd, men's rating 75.4 / slope 142 (GolfPass's tee table), men's par and handicap rows; the row adds up to its total. Unverified (third party; the club's card is not online). Offcourse (read 2026-11-13) has the older Black row (7,264 yd, 75.8/143: 554 410 462 426 475 226 375 529 207 / 353 484 426 210 448 590 380 211 498) and another men's handicap row (13 11 1 3 7 17 9 5 15 / 14 4 2 18 8 6 12 16 10): open item. OSM's pars agree with the card.
